Order

Tap a player when they’ve batted — the next inning picks up from the following batter instead of starting over. Players added to the roster are appended to the bottom of the order. A dot after a name means they're in the field for the first inning.

Switch a player off if they’re not at the game. They move to the Out list and disappear from the jersey menus, rotation and batting order until you switch them back on.

Each sport keeps its own roster, lineups and jersey colors. Removing a player keeps their name on past game results.

Games

Season

Record is counted from completed games only. Each game keeps its own copy of the quarter lineups, so later changes to your rotation never alter a finished game. Everything is saved on this device — export a backup from Settings now and then.

Team
Players

Goals, assists and quarters played are counted from saved games and goal records — nothing here is typed in by hand. Scorers left as “Unknown” count toward the team total only.

Data & backups

Everything is stored on this device only. Clearing browser data, or a different phone, means a different copy — export a backup before switching phones or clearing Safari data. Backups include every sport, all games and goals.

Install
In Safari, tap Share → Add to Home Screen to run Mini-Messi's full screen like a native app.
